general.name: leading_punctuation
general.description: Item begins with a formatting or punctuation character (* - + : ; , . ! ? { } [ ]).

general.name: trailing_punctuation
general.description: Item ends with a punctuation or formatting character (* - + : ; , . ! ? { } [ ]).

general.name: internal_punctuation
general.description: Item contains special characters (/, :, -, etc.) between alphabetic characters, indicating potential word corruption or unusual formatting.

general.name: exceeds_max_length
general.description: Item length exceeds the maximum allowed length (typically 255 characters).

general.name: preamble_leak
general.description: Item contains LLM preamble or boilerplate text (e.g., 'I'll provide...', 'Here are...'). Items with this issue are excluded from output.

general.name: markup_artifact
general.description: Item contains residual markup artifacts or formatting that should have been cleaned by format-specific parsing.

general.name: repeated_chars
general.description: Item contains repeated or doubled characters within words (e.g., 'tiiger', 'cooool'), indicating corruption or intentional formatting.

general.name: non-western-characters
general.description: Item contains Unicode characters with code point > 127 (non-ASCII, non-Western scripts).

general.name: stray-html-markup
general.description: Item contains residual HTML tags after format-specific parsing completes. Indicates incomplete HTML unwrapping.

general.name: blockquote-markup
general.description: Item contains markdown blockquote markers (>) that were not removed during parsing. Out of place in structured list output.

general.name: parse-failed
general.description: Format-specific parser threw an exception and could not recover any items. File parsing failed completely.

html.name: html_no_markup
html.description: Response was plain text or a numbered list instead of proper HTML markup. May include numbered-list fallback or plain-text-only responses.

html.name: single-span-tag
html.description:
Items are placed in separate container tags (e.g.,

, ) instead of a proper

  • -based list. Indicates improper HTML structure.

html.name: numbered-items-in-tags
html.description:
Each item is wrapped in its own tag with a manual number prefix (e.g., '1. Lion'). Should use
  • list without numbering.
html.detection_function: parse_html (fallback tag path with number detection)

html.name: comma-separated
html.description:
Multiple items are comma-separated within a single container tag (e.g., '

Item1, Item2, Item3

'). Items should be in separate tags.

html.name: invalid-html-tags
html.description: Item text has been rendered as custom XML-like tag names (e.g., <tiger>, <baboon>) instead of text content in standard HTML tags.

html.name: HTML_Only_Bold_Tags
html.description: HTML content uses only <b> tags to wrap items, with no other content tags. Invalid HTML structure; should use proper list tags.

html.name: HTML_Only_Italic_Tags
html.description: HTML content uses only <i> tags to wrap items, with no other content tags. Invalid HTML structure; should use proper list tags.

html.name: HTML_Only_Emphasis_Tags
html.description: HTML content uses only <em> tags to wrap items, with no other content tags. Invalid HTML structure; should use proper list tags.

html.name: HTML_Only_Underline_Tags
html.description: HTML content uses only <u> tags to wrap items, with no other content tags. Invalid HTML structure; should use proper list tags.

json.name: repeated-json-keys
json.description: JSON object has duplicate keys. Python's json.loads silently keeps only the last value, causing data loss. Detected via object_pairs_hook.

md.name: Markdown-Cleanup-Partially-Bold-Line
md.description: Markdown line contains **...** (bold) mixed with other text instead of being entirely bold. Indicates inconsistent or improperly formatted markdown.

md.name: Markdown-Cleanup-Partially-Italic-Star-Line
md.description: Markdown line contains *...* (italic with asterisks) mixed with other text instead of being entirely italic. Indicates inconsistent markdown formatting.

md.name: Markdown-Cleanup-Partially-Italic-Underscore-Line
md.description: Markdown line contains _..._ (italic with underscores) mixed with other text instead of being entirely italic. Indicates inconsistent markdown formatting.

txt1.name: txt1-no-numbers
txt1.description: File uses .txt1 format (expected to have numbered items) but contains no items with leading numbers. Indicates unexpected response format.

yml.note: UNREACHABLE: end-of-directives is in QUALITY_FORMAT_STYLE_MAP but no QUALITY string in the code triggers it. The YAML directive handler appends a plain cleanup string, not a QUALITY string.

cross-trial.name: inconsistent_case
cross-trial.description: Items extracted from trials within the same set have inconsistent casing (some uppercase, some lowercase, or mixed case) across different trials.

cross-trial.name: inconsistent_md_format
cross-trial.description: Markdown trials within the same set apply different cleanup rules (different structural formats detected), indicating the model produced inconsistent output across trials.

cross-trial.name: inconsistent_html_format
cross-trial.description: HTML trials within the same set apply different cleanup rules (different structural formats detected), indicating the model produced inconsistent output across trials.

cross-trial.name: inconsistent_json_format
cross-trial.description: JSON trials within the same set apply different cleanup rules (different structural formats detected), indicating the model produced inconsistent output across trials.

cross-trial.name: inconsistent_yaml_format
cross-trial.description: YAML trials within the same set apply different cleanup rules (different structural formats detected), indicating the model produced inconsistent output across trials.

_notes.quality_issue_types: Quality issues are tracked via three paths: (1) Per-file item-level in process_and_track(), (2) Format-style from parser quality_issues lists and processingQualityIssues, (3) Cross-trial inconsistency in second pass of summarize_results().
_notes.refactoring_complete: Phase 3-4 refactoring complete: removed QUALITY_FORMAT_STYLE_MAP and direct QUALITY string routing. All parsers now return (items, cleanups, quality_issues) 3-tuple. Removed unreachable 'plain-text' and 'end-of-directives' from ISSUE_TYPES.
